summary: Inventory every Rust shader module and rigid-body capability group; enforce mirrored paths, mapped Python symbols and explicit added/removed module dispositions.
regressions: New and removed Rust modules cannot silently disappear from the inventory
Moved or unmapped TileLang shaders fail the audit
Missing symbols and unclassified operations are rejected
differences: No physics arithmetic changes. The inventory explicitly records remaining production scene, collision, scheduling and constraint gaps.
Module presence is not a claim of complete module parity; only each named operation contract is tested.
